newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Progen says market fully informed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Progen says market fully informed.

text.p: Biotechnology group Progen Industries Ltd said on Monday it did not plan any announcements which would explain the rise in its share price.
The stock closed at A$13.00, up A$3.60 on turnover of 61,000 shares. "There are no pending announcements," the company said in response to a stock exchange query about the price rise.

"Results for the December half-year are scheduled for next week," it said. "The company is not aware of any information concerning it that could, if it was generally available to the public, might be regarded as an explanation for recent trading."
However, the company noted that its announcement in late January concerning significant results from its anti-cancer compound PI-88 had received widespread media coverage.
"Broking industry sources indicate that a significant portion of the buying is coming from new overseas investors," Progen said.

Progen, which was floated in 1995, has spent about A$1 million a year to fund research into developing an anti-cancer compound at the John Curtin School of Medical Research at the Australian National University in Canberra.
